recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: hackers scrolling headlines through a terminal interface
abandoned smart home gadgets piling up in digital graveyards
federated chat rooms speaking plain IRC again
hurricane polo gathering off mexico's pacific coast
autumn dusk settling over san francisco at thirteen degrees
partly cloudy sky thinning toward an early sunset

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Hold to charge a phosphor cursor, release to jump between federated IRC nodes — land each hop before the TUI buffer scrolls past your window.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: threading five nodes in one unbroken hop chain without touching the scroll edge
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: buffer scrolls faster, decoy channels appear, latency ghosts erase missed hops
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: amber phosphor terminal on black glass

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Swipe dying smart-home gadgets left into e-waste or right onto a salvage shelf before the graveyard pile topples — half the devices look identical until you inspect them.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clearing an entire dusty shelf in one decisive cascade
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: gadgets tumble faster, firmware-update traps mimic keepers, shelf tilts and slides
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: dusty product-photo collage with faded packaging

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Tap in rhythm to chain phone shortcuts into a living agent pipeline — each beat fires the next GitHub Action node before the sunrise ship deadline.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: nailing three linked agents in one unbroken groove before dawn breaks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: polyrhythms stack, nodes overlap, tempo drifts upward, stalled nodes freeze the queue
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: monospace wireframe on dark glass with one neon accent per node

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick rain bands around Hurricane Polo's shrinking eye to steer them away from coastal tiles — sloppy arcs flood the shore before the round ends.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: watching one storm band trace a perfect parabola into open ocean
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind shear rotates bands mid-flight, eye wall contracts, coastal safe zones shrink
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor weather radar over a dusk pacific horizon
